messages.subject: Error compiling stan to C++ not caught by debugger.
parts:
I'm having a weird problem with a hierarchical multivariate normal model. When I run the stan function all of the compiled c++ code is printed out and followed by this obscure error message, which mentions the linear_congruential_engine. I don't know why my code would be using this, as a google search tells me that the linear_congruential_engine is for obtaining random integers, and all of my distributions here are continuous.
